name: Autumn
overview: Scripture reveals that the cycles of nature, including autumn's harvest season, are ordained by God to sustain His creation, as affirmed in Genesis 8:22 and Deuteronomy 11:14, where seedtime and harvest occur in due season with God's provision of rain. The land's fruitful increase is a tangible blessing from the LORD, who shepherds His people and ensures their needs are met (Psalms 23:1; Psalms 85:12). This divine ordering reflects God's faithfulness and care, encouraging believers to trust in His sovereign timing and goodness throughout the seasons of life.
